stop_records.reaction: I am stopping here. The storm came at 10:00 and the supplies stayed dry; the game ended itself. I pressed I am stopping in Feedback and the note box filled itself with I am stopping - I did not type that. I did not submit. I liked the eight small honest confessions, but by the end they were all the same shape and the ending gave nobody a voice. I would not leave it running. I might return another evening on desktop if the people remembered what they told me.
